title: The Maya Hero Twins and the Lords of Death

scenes.caption: What if two brothers had to outwit the lords of the underworld? In K'iche' Maya tradition, Hunahpu and Xbalanque were summoned to Xibalba after the Lords of Death heard them playing ball on the road. The brothers entered knowing the underworld wanted them dead.
scenes.visual_evidence: the brothers approach a monumental underworld entrance while hidden lords watch from above
required_visuals: messengers summon Hunahpu and Xbalanque from a ballcourt road
the underworld staircase opens before them
the Lords of Death watch from Xibalba

scenes.caption: The Lords sent the brothers through the Houses of Darkness, Blades, Cold, Jaguars, Fire, and Bats. They extinguished torches, avoided blades, endured the cold, and escaped the animals by working together.
scenes.visual_evidence: bats, blades, and creatures close around the brothers as each passage becomes more dangerous
scenes.emotional_turn: the underworld tests their courage and cooperation
required_visuals: the House of Darkness and House of Blades

scenes.caption: At the ballcourt, the Lords tried to humiliate them with a rigged game and cruel demands. The twins kept the ball in play, recognized the false instructions, and used deception to survive the next test.

scenes.caption: The Lords killed the twins, burned their bodies, and cast their bones into a river. Hunahpu and Xbalanque returned in disguise as performers who killed and revived one another.
scenes.visual_evidence: ritual transformation and return leave the lords fascinated while the twins control the spectacle
required_visuals: the Lords kill the twins and cast their bones into a river
the twins return disguised as traveling performers
the performers kill and revive one another before the watching Lords

scenes.caption: The Lords of Death were fascinated. One Death and Seven Death demanded that the performers kill and revive them as well. The twins sacrificed the Lords, then left them dead.

scenes.caption: With One Death and Seven Death dead, Xibalba lost its rule over the living. The Popol Vuh records the twins' victory: the death lords fall, and a new cosmic order begins.

required_visuals: the twins rise into a reordered sky
